# Fixtures in this directory that are structurally valid per
# schemas/v1alpha1/result.schema.json, but are rejected by
# v1alpha1.DecodeResult because of a Go-only semantic rule that JSON Schema
# cannot express. See schemas/README.md for the full list of such rules.
#
# One file name per line. Comments start with '#'.

# The "no secret markers" rule (PEM headers, bearer tokens, etc.) in
# error.summary is enforced only by validateOpaqueText in Go; the schema
# only bounds length.
error-summary-pem.json

# Rejecting control characters (including newlines) in error.summary is a
# Go-only rule (validateOpaqueText); the schema only bounds length.
error-summary-newline.json

# finishedAt >= startedAt is a Go-only cross-field ordering rule; the schema
# validates each timestamp's format independently.
finishedat-before-startedat.json

# Unicode line/paragraph separators and format (bidi) characters are
# rejected by validateOpaqueText in Go only; the schema bounds length only.
error-summary-line-separator.json
error-summary-bidi-override.json

# The secret-marker heuristic in error.summary is matched case-insensitively
# for header/key=value-shaped markers (password=, bearer , basic ,
# authorization:, sig=, etc.) by validateOpaqueText in Go only; the schema
# only bounds length.
error-summary-password-mixed-case.json
error-summary-password-upper.json
error-summary-bearer-upper.json
error-summary-basic-auth.json
error-summary-sas-sig.json
